rows.q: Which word is the adjective in this sentence: Maurice has a beautiful dress?
rows.bestText: Beautiful describes the dress, so it is the adjective.

rows.q: Okello is 10 years old and 100 cm tall. Akena is 8 years old and 110 cm tall. Who is taller?
rows.bestText: Akena is 110 cm tall and Okello is 100 cm tall, so Akena is taller.

rows.q: How are hospitals important in our communities?
rows.bestText: Hospitals give treatment to the sick in the community.

rows.q: Why is central Tanzania not good for cattle keeping?
rows.bestText: Tsetse flies bite cattle and spread diseases, so cattle cannot thrive there.

rows.q: The area of a square is 144 square centimetres. Find the length of each side.
rows.bestText: The square root of 144 is 12, so each side is 12 cm.

rows.q: How is a splint useful to a person with a fractured lower leg?
rows.bestText: A splint holds the broken leg still so the bones do not move.
